slots.name: eyebrow
slots.about: the small line over the heading: who picked the collection

slots.name: heading
slots.about: the collection's name; its first letter stands in for the art

slots.name: blurb
slots.about: why these were picked; folds to two lines

slots.name: items
slots.about: the collection in order: id (1 up), name, line, saved (true or false); 0 or more, with none the empty line shows

slots.name: empty_line
slots.about: the line when the collection is empty

slots.name: count_line
slots.about: the line under the blurb; may read saved_count and total

slots.name: save_word
slots.about: the row button's word before saving

slots.name: saved_word
slots.about: the row button's word once saved

slots.name: save
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: saves the row's item, or unsaves it (value: it.id)

slots.name: more
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: opens or folds the blurb

empty.shows: the hero and the empty line; no count and no rows

attention.shows: saved rows' buttons fill and say so, and the count line counts them

fallback.shows: the blurb folds to two lines with a more control

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise, smooth, swap and shrink
accessibility.not_colour_alone: a saved row's button says the saved word, and the count line says how many are saved
